title: BPW-2026-0540
text:
[BUREAU OF ENGINEERING]
BPW-2026-0540
CD 15
WILMINGTON NEIGHBORHOOD GREENING AND WILMINGTON-ANAHEIM GREEN INFRASTRUCTURE CORRIDOR PROJECTS CERTIFICATION OF CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT REPORT STATE CLEARING HOUSE NO. 2025030282
Recommending the Board:
In accordance with the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) regarding the Wilmington Greening Infrastructure Projects, review, consider, adopt the findings and mitigations, and forward this report and transmittals to the Los Angeles City Council with the following recommendations:
REVIEW and CONSIDER the information contained in the Project’s Environmental Impact Report (EIR), consisting of Volume One of the fully integrated Final EIR (FEIR), and Volume Two of the FEIR, which contains supporting technical studies and the record of proceedings; CERTIFY that the FEIR was completed in compliance with the CEQA; that potentially significant environmental effects of the project have been disclosed and evaluated in compliance with the CEQA; and that the FEIR reflects and expresses the City of Los Angeles’ independent judgement and analyses as the CEQA Lead Agency;
ADOPT the Projects’ CEQA Findings and Statement of Overriding Considerations;
ADOPT the Mitigation Monitoring Program;
SPECIFY that the documents constituting the record of proceedings in this matter are in the custody of the Bureau of Engineering, Department of Public Works, located at 1149 South Broadway, Suite, Los Angeles, CA 90015, and any other relevant City Department; and
APPROVE the Projects as described in the FEIR.
summary: The Board is asked to certify the environmental impact report for the Wilmington neighborhood greening and Wilmington-Anaheim green infrastructure corridor projects, adopt its findings and mitigation program, and approve the projects.
